library(tidyverse)

Experiment

library(deeptime)
library(divDyn)
## v0.8.3. See latest changes with 'news(package="divDyn")'. Default: 
## Time flows forward with 'bin', and backward with 'age' and 'slice()'.
## 
## Attaching package: 'divDyn'
## The following objects are masked from 'package:dplyr':
## 
##     collapse, slice
## The following object is masked from 'package:tidyr':
## 
##     fill
data(corals)

# this is not a proper diversity curve but it gets the point across
coral_div <- corals |> filter(stage != "") |>
  group_by(stage) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  mutate(stage_age = (stages$max_age[match(stage, stages$name)] +
                        stages$min_age[match(stage, stages$name)])/2)

{coral_div |> 
ggplot() +
  labs(title = "Number of distinct coral genus-family within stages corals from the Paleobiology Database*",
       subtitle = "deeptime::coord_geo situates data in Triassic, Jurassic, Cretaceous, Paleogene, and Neogene") +
  aes(x = stage_age) + 
  aes(y = n) +
  geom_line() + 
  scale_x_reverse() +
  labs(x = "Age (Ma)") +
  labs(y = "Coral Genera") +
  coord_geo(xlim = c(250, 0)) +
  coord_geo(dat =  list("periods", "eras")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16, 
                paper = "grey95") + 
  labs(caption = "*not a proper diversity curve -- for illustration purposes")} |> 
  codehover::ch_hover()
